//: The quests pack: daily and weekly challenge definitions as DATA
Scrap and drops'). A challenge is a pure stat predicate — never a mode.
Progress banks in sessions whose trust row grants REWARD_CHALLENGE
(public server matches); payment lands in the first settling session
that also grants REWARD_SCRAP, once per UTC period per challenge.
Daily resets at UTC midnight; weekly is the ISO week, Monday start.
The whole set must fit one result submission (8 max), per-def scrap is
capped at 500 and the manifest total at 2000 — the parser refuses
anything over, here and in the studio editor alike. `item` names a
LOCAL id in the items manifest; the release gate cross-checks it.

//achievements: Lifetime, one-shot, and paid ONCE PER PLAYER EVER. They read the lifetime
stat block the profile already keeps, so they are RETROACTIVE: adding one
pays every player who already qualifies, at their next settling match.
`wins` is deliberately absent. A sole player who does nothing for a round
is still credited a lifetime win, so pricing it would pay for idling —
measured, and recorded in HANDOVER §3. `matches`, `secondsPlayed` and
`deaths` are out for the same family of reasons. The parser refuses all
four, so this is a rule and not a convention.
title-hangar-rat and trophy-first-season had NO earn path before this:
rollMatchDrops skips titles and trophies because 'they are earned', and
nothing else granted them. These are the awards that earn them.
